description.value:
As a child of House Phiarlan, you have known wealth, fame, and beauty, yet you hold knowledge—and the power it brings—to be the greatest treasure of all. You might seek that power as an artist or performer, always listening for secrets while you dazzle the world with stories, songs, acrobatics, or art. Or you might cultivate ties with the Serpentine Table, the secretive espionage arm of your house.

Ability Scores: Dexterity, Wisdom, Charisma

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.0HHEsUor1RwXy2wh]{Mark of Shadow}

Skill Proficiencies: Deception and Stealth

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulDisguiseKi]{Disguise Kit}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulDisguiseKi]{Disguise Kit}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesFine]{Fine Clothes}, 10 GP; or (B) 50 GP
